arguments.text: Good start. Settle now into your race rhythm, smooth and long.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal: even effort near pod critical power (CP ~204 W shaft, to be checked), keep pod reserve above ~30% until 2 km to go, then spend it in the last 1.5-2 km (finish cue ~600-800 m). Watch for incidents: weed on rudder (speed per pod watt drops on both directions), pod drift (pod power vs heart rate mismatch), course change by radio. Use measure() on clean stretches to check share of pod power reaching boat and current. Avoid ground-pace targets because current flips by leg.
